Can import from or work with SSH keys and key files

listings.name: Syncthing

listings.about: Open Source Continuous File Synchronization

Reads and writes the folders you choose to sync
Can run a versioning command you configure
Keeps its device keys and web interface login

listings.plain: Finds passwords and API keys leaked in code, Git history and files, and checks whether they still work.

uses: Clones repositories and checks found keys against the services they belong to
Reads the code and files you scan
Uses keys it finds to test whether they still work, and the access tokens you give it for sources

install.to: A Linux computer or Raspberry Pi on your network

listings.name: RustDesk
listings.plain: Lets you see and control another computer remotely, like TeamViewer, to help family or reach your own PC.

uses: Connects to the other computer, through RustDesk's public servers or your own

Runs services and helpers to control the screen and input
Keeps your device ID, password and session keys

listings.name: Strata
listings.plain: Runs Qwen3.8, a strong free AI model, on an ordinary computer, with a one-click install.
listings.about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on any consumer hardware: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.

listings.name: Hob
listings.plain: A ChatGPT-style app that picks a free AI model your computer can run, and works offline.
listings.about: An easier way to use AI on your own computer. A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux. Private, and works offline.

listings.name: Yogurt
listings.plain: Takes meeting notes on your own computer, with no bot joining the call.
listings.about: Private AI meeting notes that stay on your computer. No meeting bot. Free and open source for Mac, Windows and Linux. An alternative to Granola, Otter and Fireflies.

listings.name: nanobot
listings.plain: A small personal AI assistant you host yourself and chat with from your browser or chat apps.
listings.about: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.

listings.name: Kev
listings.plain: Small Jev-style decision models you can run and train yourself. They answer yes/no, pick-one and score questions.
listings.about: Jev-like family of decision models built on top of Qwen3.5/3.8 you can train and run on your own

listings.name: ollaya
listings.plain: Runs open decision models on your own computer, the way Ollama runs chat models, behind the same API as Jev.
listings.about: Jev-compatible API server for open decision models. Ollama for decision models: pull and serve 29 model families (Laya, pplx-decider, Clef, Winnow, coba...) locally or self-hosted behind /v1/systemone. The TypeSafe SDK works unchanged: set its base URL and pick an open model. CLI, desktop app, Docke

listings.name: laya
listings.plain: An open decision engine: give it text and a typed question, and it returns a choice, a score or a yes/no.
listings.about: Non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine. Typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over any text in a single forward pass, in 100+ languages, with a router that picks the right checkpoint per request.

listings.name: AFFiNE
listings.plain: Notes, whiteboards and tables in one app that keeps your work on your computer.
listings.about: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

listings.name: GenOffice
listings.plain: A free office suite for documents, spreadsheets and slides, with an AI helper built in.
listings.about: Free, open-source AI Office suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, Markdown and HTML editors with a built-in AI agent, plus a genoffice CLI and agent skill so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can create and edit real .docx/.xlsx/.pptx files locally. Bring your own key. macOS, Windows & Linux.

listings.name: DeepTutor
listings.plain: A personal AI tutor that adapts to what you know and teaches from your own notes and files.
listings.about: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.

listings.name: Open Design
listings.plain: A design workspace where you and AI agents make prototypes, websites, slides and videos together.

listings.name: Plannotator
listings.plain: Lets you mark up your coding assistant's plans and code changes, then sends your notes back in one click.
listings.about: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

listings.name: CLI-Anything

listings.about: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/

listings.plain: Turns a codebase and its docs into a map Claude can search, instead of reading every file.

listings.name: NOOP
listings.plain: Pairs with your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth and keeps your health data on your phone or Mac, with no account or membership.
listings.about: Offline WHOOP companion — pair your strap over Bluetooth, keep all data on your own device. No cloud, no account, no subscription.

listings.about: Open source Granola AI Alternative

listings.name: Dyad
